Dear Sir/Ma’am, 
 
Pursuant to Regulation 30 of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and 
Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, the Audio Recording Link of Earnings Call for all

https://www.lumaxworld.in/lumaxindustries/transcript.html
